__broaden__.αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, governed by a preposition: ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ’from him’ · also intensive with a noun, masc. gen. sg.: ’Alcinous himself’ (αὐτοῦ Ἀλκινόοιο) · also reflexive intensive gen. sg. after a personal pronoun: σέο τ’ αὐτοῦ ’and of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun of a thing, ’from it’, after ἐκ (ἐκ δ’ αὐτοῦ πείρατ’ ἀνήφθω, of the mast) · also masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive sense, ’his own’: αὐτοῦ ἐνεύναιον ’his own bedding’, αὐτοῦ βώτορες ’his own herdsmen’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun with a noun, ’his’: ὀστέα δ’ αὐτοῦ ’and his bones’ · also intensive gen. sg. with a demonstrative and noun: τοῦδ’ αὐτοῦ λυκάβαντος ’this very year’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun of a thing, ’upon it’, after ἐπί (ἐπ’ αὐτοῦ, of a stool) · also gen. sg. pronoun of comparison after a comparative: ’than he’ (προγενέστερος αὐτοῦ ’older than he’) · also masc. gen. sg. after περί: ’about himself’ (περί τ’ αὐτοῦ καὶ περὶ πάντων) · also plain gen. sg. pronoun governed by ἄγχι ’near’: ’him’ (ἄγχι δ’ αὐτοῦ ’close beside him’)
__broaden__.αὐτῇ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’for herself’ · also plain anaphoric pronoun referring to a thing, dat. sg. with ἐν: ’in it’ (ἐν αὐτῇ, of the ship) · also reinforcing a 1st-person pronoun: ’myself’ (ἐμοί περ αὐτῇ, μοι αὐτῇ ’for me myself’) · also reinforcing a 2nd-person pronoun: ’you yourself’ (σοὶ ὧδ’ αὐτῇ ’for you yourself’) · also dat. sg. of a thing, no ἐν, ’against it’ or ’against her’, with ποτικέκλιται (referent uncertain: pillar or queen) · also plain pronoun, dat. sg. with μίσγεται: ’with her’ (οὐδέ τις αὐτῇ μίσγεται ’nor does anyone consort with her’) · also plain pronoun, dat. sg. after ἅμα: ’with her’ (ἅμα δ’ ἀμφίπολοι φέρον αὐτῇ, of Circe) · also intensive with a noun, fem. dat. sg. with ἐν: ’very, same’ (αὐτῇ ἐνὶ χώρῃ ’in that very place’)
__broaden__.γένοιτο: γίγνομαι — become, happen, turn out; aor. opt. 3 sg. (ὅπως ἄριστα γένοιτο ’how it might turn out best’) · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish with μή: μὴ ... φίλον γένοιτο ’may it not prove pleasing’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish after αἲ γάρ: αἲ γὰρ τοῦτο γένοιτο ’would that this might happen’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish after εἰ γάρ: εἰ γὰρ … ἔρις γένοιτο ’if only a contest might arise’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a fear clause after μή: ’lest it come to be’ (μὴ … ἀμφαδὰ ἔργα γένοιτο ’lest the matter become public’) · also aor. opt. 3 sg., potential with κε: ’it would be’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg., potential with ἄν: ’would become’ (ἡμῖν δ’ ἂν ἐλέγχεα ταῦτα γένοιτο ’and to us these would become reproaches’)
__broaden__.γυναικῶν: γυνή — woman; fem. gen. pl., partitive with δῖα: ’heavenly-one of women’ · also partitive with ἀρίστη: ’best of women’ · also possessive gen. with a noun: ἔργα γυναικῶν ’the works of women’ · also gen. after a verb of surpassing, ’above, beyond women’ (περίεσσι γυναικῶν) · also gen. pl. dependent on a noun of speech, ’of … women’ (φάτιν ἀνδρῶν ἠδὲ γυναικῶν ’the talk of men and of women’)
__broaden__.διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: διὰ … τινάξῃ = διατινάξῃ ’shake apart, shatter’ · also + acc., causal, ’through, thanks to, by the aid of’ (διὰ … Ἀθήνην) · also as adverb/preverb in tmesis with κοσμηθέντες (διὰ … κοσμηθέντες = διακοσμηθέντες ’drawn up in divisions’) · also + gen., ’through, among’ (διὰ μήλων ’among the flocks’) · also prep. + gen., ’through’ (διὰ πτόλιος ’through the city’) · also in tmesis with ἧκε (διὰ … ἧκε = διῆκε ’shot through’) · also in tmesis with ἦλθε (διὰ … ἦλθε = διῆλθε ’went through’)
__broaden__.δόμεναι: δίδωμι — give; aor. inf., epic -μεναι, used as imperative: ’give’ · also inf. after ὀτρύνω, ’to give’ (πομπὴν ὀτρύνω δόμεναι ’I urge (him) to give a conveyance’) · also inf. complementing an impersonal ’it seemed better’: ’to give’ (κέρδιον εἶναι … δόμεναι ’better to give’) · also inf. after the impersonal χρή: ’to give’ (σε χρὴ δόμεναι ’you ought to give’) · also inf. complementing ἔτλης: ’to bring oneself to give’ · also inf. after φθονέω: ’(do not) begrudge giving’ (οὔτε τινὰ φθονέω δόμεναι) · also inf. after ἐάω, ’to give’ (οὐκ ἐάσουσιν … δόμεναι ’they will not allow (it) to be given’) · also inf. complementing ἐθέλω, ’(if I) wish to give’ (αἴ κ’ ἐθέλωμι … δόμεναι)
__broaden__.δώῃ: δίδωμι — give, grant; aor. subj. 3 sg. __broaden__.ἐπιστάμενος: ἐπίσταμαι — know, understand, be skilled in; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., + gen. of comparison: ’skilled beyond (all men)’ · also pres. part. + gen. of the thing known: ’skilled in’ (φόρμιγγος ἐπιστάμενος καὶ ἀοιδῆς ’skilled in lyre and song’)
__broaden__.ἔκαμον: κάμνω — grow weary, toil; aor. 3 pl. (ἔκαμον): ’grew weary’ · also aor. 1 sg. + part.: ’I grew weary (of)’ (ἔκαμον τανύων ’I toiled stringing’)
